decodeEvidence.scope: Existing full-decode evidence supplied by the lead agent; this review independently hashed the movie and inspected all ten decoded PNGs, without replaying the complete movie.

method: All ten final decoded PNGs were displayed in the image viewer and inspected. Observations derive from the actual displayed images, not filenames. Requested sample times may be rounded to a decoded frame boundary.
overall: All eight chapter subjects are represented and captions fit their cards. The previously reported horizon/facade tonal discontinuity and first-chapter subtitle overrun are absent in the reviewed final samples. Harbor boats, fountain details, street-corridor framing and sparse lane traffic are visible. No blocking visual defect was observed in these ten frames.

previousFindingsResolved.observation: The previously visible horizontal brightness break across distant facades is absent in these corrected final frames.
The long first-chapter subtitle now fits within the dark caption card with a right margin.

limits: Only ten sampled frames were visually reviewed; this is not an end-to-end motion or transition review.
Successful full decode and exact cadence are distinct from sampled image quality.
Still inspection cannot certify temporal denoising, animation smoothness, vehicle speed, water motion or complete collision clearance.
Procedural geometry and materials remain interpretive rather than survey-accurate or fully photorealistic.

observations: Wrigley clock faces, white crown and facade relief are visible at left; the Gothic Tribune crown is clearly framed across the street corridor.
The complete title and long subtitle fit within the dark caption card; footer attribution is readable.
limitations: Foreground building bases extend below the frame; nearby generic facade grids are visibly simplified.

observations: The route is farther north along the street corridor, with reflective nearby facades and the distant braced Hancock tower and both antenna tips visible.
The long first-chapter subtitle fits within its card with a visible right margin.
limitations: Nearby generic buildings dominate this sample; the opening clock and Gothic towers are outside the frame.

observations: The historic limestone tower is framed from entrance to upper lantern, with arched openings, buttresses and block joints readable in shade.
Trees and benches sit beside the front elevation; title, subtitle and attribution fit.
limitations: The facade is shaded, openings are dark, and the masonry and rounded foliage remain procedural approximations.

observations: A close upward facade study shows stone/glass panels, dark mullions, storefront framing and reflected light.
Title, subtitle, attribution and progress indicator are readable.
limitations: The building top is outside the frame; dark storefront glazing reveals little interior detail.

observations: The tapered dark tower, large exterior diagonals and rooftop structures remain legible against a hazy city backdrop.
The previous horizontal tonal break is absent from the visible horizon and nearby facades. The long title and subtitle fit their card.
limitations: Antenna tips and the lower tower extend outside this close aerial composition; distant city blocks use repetitive simplified geometry.

observations: The full outer basin, tiered center, sculptural green forms, arcing jets and rippled reflective water are visible without a foreground obstruction.
The title and long subtitle fit their card; surrounding paths, planted beds, benches and sparse distant traffic are readable.
limitations: Jets are authored smooth arcs and sculptural forms are stylized; still inspection does not establish fluid simulation.

observations: Tree rows, garden paths, planted beds and a broad skyline form an open park composition; sparse vehicles are visible on the road at right.
Fountain jets and part of the basin remain visible behind foreground tree crowns. Caption and attribution fit.
limitations: Foreground trees partly obstruct the basin; repeated foliage and generic facades remain visibly simplified.

observations: Blue-and-white moored boats show cabins, decks, masts and hanging fenders beside clearly separated finger piers.
Rippled water reflects the skyline and a broad bright light streak. The long harbor subtitle fits within its card and attribution remains readable.
limitations: The bright foreground water reflection is locally near white; fine grain and water motion cannot be judged from one still. Repeated boats are representative models.

observations: The elevated composition shows the river mouth, lake, road bridge, harbor slips and skyline; small vehicles occupy the bridge lanes.
The earlier horizontal facade-brightness boundary is absent; the lake fades into the hazy background without the dark sky strip. Caption and attribution remain readable.
limitations: Some waterfront parcels are broad plain surfaces with sparse detail. The subtitle describes the full two-minute route, while this compilation chapter is shorter.

observations: The closing frame shows the park and fountain against the skyline, with multiple red, white and dark vehicles clearly placed within the foreground divided-road lanes.
The previous horizontal tonal boundary no longer crosses the skyline facades; caption, attribution and nearly complete progress fill remain readable.
limitations: Trees, path details and distant building models remain simplified. A still cannot verify vehicle steering, speed or spawn transitions.
